ops.expect: Spire Gully right (Alpenkuhl), part of the Hairpin Crags, is reached from the same large pullout at the hairpin turns on SR-20 near Washington Pass used for Kangaroo Temple. Looking up toward South Early Winter Spire from the pullout, Spire Gully is the obvious gully just below and left; Alpenkuhl is its sunnier, south-facing right side (the left side is known as Tiger Wall). The approach is one of the shortest at Washington Pass — a direct walk/scramble of roughly 10-15 minutes straight up from the highway, snow-covered in early season and a worn boot path later in summer.
ops.value: Park at the apex of the hairpin turn on SR-20 below Washington Pass. Follow the climbers' trail up toward Quicksilver Slab and Spire Gully, then cut right into a dry creek bed and climb the slabs above it into the Ice Box. The upper, entrance slab has a fixed line; the lower slab does not. Both are smooth and slippery, and worse when wet.
